# Airlie Marketing
> Charlottesville-based marketing for local service businesses that do great work but aren't getting found online. Fixed-price services bought one at a time — Google Business Profile, local SEO and AI visibility, reviews, social posts and websites. Nothing renews unless the customer buys it again.

- Business: Airlie Marketing
- Founder: Micah Scott
- Based in: Charlottesville, Virginia
- Website: https://airliemarketing.com
- Services and prices: https://airliemarketing.com/products
- Phone / text: (434) 218-0755
- Email: micah@airliemarketing.com

## One-time services
- Google Profile Setup — $395: profile claimed or built, categories researched, description and services, photos, seeded Q&A, handover.
- Local SEO Foundation — $550: listings audit and corrections, keyword map, on-page work on up to six pages, LocalBusiness structured data, Search Console, and AI visibility work (knowledge profile, llms.txt, before-and-after AI check).
- Review Engine Setup — $500: review link and QR code, request and reply templates, crew script, alerts.
- Website Refresh — from $450, scoped before it's priced.
- One-Page Website Build — $950, or $650 with a plan; half up front, half at launch.
- Strategy Call — $125 for one hour.

## 30-day services (end after 30 days, never auto-renew)
- Google Profile Management — $195
- Review Management — $225
- 30-Day Social Content Pack — $350 (12 Facebook and Instagram posts)

## Plans (bundles of the 30-day services)
- Get Found — $355 per 30 days: Google Profile Management + Review Management.
- Grow — $655 per 30 days: Get Found + 30-Day Social Content Pack.
- Pro — coming soon (adds paid ads management).

## Coming soon
- Google Local Ads and Meta Local Ads, launch and management.

## How to buy
- Fill in the contact form at https://airliemarketing.com/contact, or text or email Micah. He confirms what's included and sends an invoice to pay online.

## Terms
- The 30 days start when Airlie has everything it needs from the customer, not the day they pay.
- Refundable until work starts.
- No contracts. Nothing renews unless the customer buys it again.
